chapter: Struttin' Time, chronology and Chicago singers
title: Avoiding the Big Apple and Harlem hangouts
summary: She never frequented Harlem show-business hangouts; she thinks she worked at Small's for a while.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I was going to ask you, do you remember in that place called The Big Apple on the corner of 135th Street and 7th Avenue --
-- but that was sort of a place at one time where a lot of show business people used to go.
Yeah, lot of show -- oh, yes. But not me, I -- you know, as I say, I hope you don't think I'm, you know, but I never did frequent any of those places, never.
Well, if you -- if you had, you probably wouldn't be here, --
I guess not. I never frequented any of those places. Now, I tell you, I -- several times -- oh, I
did -- I think I worked at Small's a while.
I think I did work at Small's. If I'm not mistaken, I worked at Small's.
